caseContext.description: Sanitized ACME Health provider onboarding case details.

touchpointRequest.description: Optional touchpoint or drafting request, such as Day 1, five-day, 30-day, 90-day, or start-date push.

audience.description: Optional target audience, such as provider, manager, onboarding navigator, or mixed.

startDatePushReason.description: Optional sanitized reason for a revised start date.

cadence.description: Touchpoint cadence or drafting scenario used for the response.

providerMessage.description: Draft message for the provider, grounded in the case context.

managerMessage.description: Draft message for the manager or onboarding owner, grounded in the case context.

startDatePushMessage.description: Sanitized start-date-push message when requested, otherwise an empty string.

requiresApproval.description: True when the draft should be approved before sending.

complianceNotes.description: Short notes about what must be reviewed before sending.
